services:
  nas-web:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: nas-web
    ports:
      - "8088:80"
    volumes:
      - /mnt/Ila/ia3264666/nas-web/index.html:/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html:ro
      - /mnt/Ila/ia3264666/nas-web/styles.css:/usr/share/nginx/html/styles.css:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
